sources: Suffering's End (arts unit). Skill 3, sk_wpn_funnel_0020 (rmxlinux Json/SkillData; values from SkillPatchTable at the weapon's skill-3 level: nature_dmg_up, nature_dmg_up2, duration). Its cardAttributeModifier (attribute 87, Arts Intensity + phy_spell_up) and skills 1-2 stay in the stat panel. Batch-4 report docs/kit-batches/batch-4/chr_0030_zhuangfy.md rows S1-S2.

abilityEvent 127 (the wielder applies an Arts Burst) + CheckTimedMarkerCondition / CreateTimedMarker 0.1 s (the data's literal) -> buff_wpn_funnel_0020_intensityup (attribute 54 formulaItem 5, Nature DMG + nature_dmg_up, `duration`; stackingType 11 without priority key, the literal maxStackCnt 4 of its BuffData, no key: layers, each its own timer); then CheckBuffStackNumAdvanced intensityup >= 4 (the data's literal) -> buff_wpn_funnel_0020_maxup (Nature DMG + nature_dmg_up2, `duration`, stackingType 4: refreshed). abilityEvent 209 (a buff layer of the wielder ends) with intensityup below 4 -> FinishBuffAdvanced maxup: when a layer runs out (buffEnded) and fewer than 4 are left.

Description (report S2): "When the wielder applies an Arts Burst, the wielder gains Nature DMG +{nature_dmg_up} for {duration}s. Max stacks: 4. Duration of each stack is counted separately. Effect only triggers once every 0.1s. At 4 stacks, the wielder gains an additional Nature DMG +{nature_dmg_up2}."

buffs.label: Suffering's End: Nature DMG per Arts Burst
Suffering's End: Nature DMG at 4 layers

triggers.note: Any Arts Burst the wielder applies (no CheckOriginSkillType: from any of the wielder's hits).
